Match the approved S2 cover's very heavy, tight lowercase grotesk headlines in #2A2A2A; centered regular italic subtitle in #6B6B6B; accent #F26445. Keep the same visual scale, spacing, and hierarchy as LW-CAR-0020 slide 1. No added words, punctuation, watermark, signature, or slide number.

Center the exact italic subtitle below it. In the lower half show one full-body, front-view, bald and faceless realistic anatomical mannequin standing with hands on hips. Entire figure from head to feet, with no crop. Mannequin is white / light-grey with fine grey anatomical shading and subtle muscle fibres, smooth featureless pelvis, and dark #2A2A2A shorts. Fill only the quadriceps, adductors, and calves coral #F26445; all other muscles remain white / light-grey. No other colored muscles, props or equipment. Keep figure style and linework consistent with the realistic S2 mannequin in the references.

Ensure the full figure and all three exact strings are visible and separate. Return exactly one finished slide, not a collage or mockup.
